name: aware-extension
description: Local browser extension for inspecting web content before an AI agent reads it.

scripts.build: esbuild src/popup.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/popup.js --platform=browser --target=chrome102 && esbuild src/content.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/content.js --platform=browser --target=chrome102 && cp manifest.json popup.html popup.css dist/ && cp src/report-view.css dist/report-view.css
